performers: Conversation Corner at Keys The Election Hangover Cure: Community Coffee Chat with Peter and Romalyn
events.description: What happened?What do the results mean for my community?Where are resources? Where can I find joy?WHAT NOW? They may not have all the answers, but North Beach community leaders Peter Swords Stevens (Telegraph Hill Dwellers president, Working Families Party) and Romalyn Schmaltz (North Beach Now) want to hear your questions and explore our next steps[...]
